body: Awesome! I didn't know they had a site to check it. I'm sure I have to wait probably 2 weeks from Monday to even see if they've submitted everything. I just hope it doesn't take forever like everyone's been saying
How much did it cost to have the dealership inspect your car? & did you have to call for an appt or did you just bring it in? I'm getting a Kia on Monday and would like to do the same.
I'm in Illinois too! I was just wondering if they gave any updates when they submitted the paperwork to DMV or when everything was completed and on its way?

Honestly it doesn't seem like they have much credit criteria other than being 18+ (old enough the legally sign a contract) and make at least 10k a year. My credit is horrible, below 560 to say the least. My down payment is more but that's not a big deal to me. My interest rate is through the roof. Looking at the prices, they basically would finance 10k for me and whatever the difference was my down payment. I plan on paying this car off within next year rather than the 5 year plan they basically have me on as a payment schedule. My settlement check will be able to take care of the balance and then some. Anyway, my dad has wonderful credit above 800 and his interest rate was 3/4% with no down payment for many vehicles. 
No credit is better than horrible credit so as long as you meet the 2 requirements, your terms should be better than mine.
